summary: Completed V5 fault injection tests with REAL failure injection. Created 4 narrow backend-only tests demonstrating actual crash scenarios, poison jobs, and replay protection. Fixed test_v5_architecture.py to rename normal outbox test. All tests use monkeypatch for fault injection and verify recovery mechanisms.

notes: Motor event loop issue requires tests to be run individually (documented in test file and runner script)
All fault injection tests pass when run individually via run_fault_tests.sh

passed_tests: test_crash_between_close_and_enqueue: Demonstrates crash after finalize but before enqueue, verifies durable outbox (grading_status=queued) survives and maintenance repairs it
test_poison_job_retry: Injects freeze_ledger failure, verifies job retries 3 times with exponential backoff, fails after budget, and can be manually retried after fix
test_done_report_job_lease_protection: Verifies done report job path is not reset on retry API, require_lease rejects expired leases, unique lease key in path prevents overwrites
test_replay_protection: Verifies exact body replay returns original receipt, new late save returns 409, solution access forbidden on active attempts
test_cross_set_start_conflicts: Correctly expects 409 when same start_key used across different sets (already passing in test_v5_architecture.py)
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_v5_faults.py (NEW - 4 fault injection tests with real monkeypatch)
/app/backend/tests/run_fault_tests.sh (NEW - runner script for individual test execution)

test_1_crash_between_close_and_enqueue.fault_injection: Monkeypatched ensure_grade to raise RuntimeError during finalize
verified_behavior: finalize completes with status=completed, grading_status=queued (durable outbox)
NO job created (crash prevented enqueue)
NO ledger created (crash prevented grading)
Maintenance repair via ensure_grade creates job
run_job completes grading and creates ledger
Attempt grading_status becomes ready
Job retries 3 times with next_run_at set
After 3 attempts, job status becomes failed
Extra run does not change failed job
Attempt remains completed but grading_status not ready
Manual retry after removing poison succeeds
Ledger created after successful retry

test_3_done_report_job_lease_protection.fault_injection: Simulated stale lease with expired lease_until to test require_lease
verified_behavior: Report job completes with path stored
Retry API on done job returns same job without changes
Path unchanged in DB after retry
require_lease correctly rejects expired lease with RuntimeError
Path contains unique lease identifier to prevent overwrites
Save seq1 and seq2 complete successfully
Attempt closed via submit
Replay seq1 exact body returns original receipt with duplicate=True
New late save returns 409 (attempt closed)
Solution access on active attempt returns 403 (forbidden)

execution_details.note: Tests must be run individually due to Motor event loop binding at module import time. Session-scoped event loop does not work with Motor. Each test creates its own event loop.
execution_details.qa_only_flag: All created test documents have qa_only=true in answers field
